abstract: Twenty-five patients with a malignant germ cell tumor of the mediastinum were treated at the National Cancer Center Hospital, Tokyo. Three patients had pure seminomas while 22 had a nonseminomatous histology. The treatment modalities consisted of surgery alone in 7 patients, surgery with chemotherapy and/or radiation in 14, and chemotherapy and/or radiation without surgery in 4. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy was administered in nine patients, one of whom successfully underwent high-dose chemotherapy with autologous bone marrow transplantation after resection of the tumor. A complete response was achieved in only five patients. The overall survival rate at 5 years was 33.5% and the median survival time was 51 weeks. Eight patients (32%), all of whom underwent surgery either with or without chemotherapy and/or radiation, were free of disease with a mean follow-up period of 439 weeks (72-1,120 weeks). The median survival times for 14 patients undergoing combined modality treatment, 7 patients undergoing surgery alone, and 4 patients undergoing chemotherapy and/or radiation were 83, 16, and 18 weeks, respectively.
abstract_ja: 東京の国立がんセンター病院で、縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍の患者25例を治療した。セミノーマ3例、非セミノーマ22例であった。治療は、手術単独が7例、手術と化学療法および/または放射線療法の併用が14例、化学療法および/または放射線療法のみ(手術なし)が4例であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法は9例に施行され、そのうち1例は腫瘍切除後に自家骨髄移植を伴う大量化学療法を完遂できた。完全奏効は5例のみで得られた。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は33.5%、中央生存期間は51週であった。手術を受けた8例(32%)は無病であり、フォローアップの平均期間は439週(72〜1,120週)であった。集学的治療を受けた14例の中央生存期間は83週、手術単独の7例は16週、化学療法および/または放射線療法の4例は18週であった。
